skills.name: apptweak-dashboard-builder
skills.description: Turns a plain-language request into a working dashboard that pairs live AppTweak data, retrieved only through the OAuth-authenticated AppTweak MCP server, with one or more other data sources. Refines a vague ask into a concrete brief first: what question it answers, whether the required AppTweak account is connected, which other sources are live versus stand-ins, and what a null result would mean. Looks up current API facts through the connected AppTweak MCP and documentation tools rather than relying on memory. Use when asked to build a dashboard using AppTweak data, pair AppTweak with a CRM/spreadsheet/CSV, or build something that shows live AppTweak data.
headings: Building a dashboard against live AppTweak data (durable, not hardcoded)
Why this skill is written the way it is
Step 1 — Turn the ask into a brief
Step 2 — Ground rules that hold regardless of what AppTweak is paired with
Step 3 — Learn AppTweak's API fresh, from the tools you actually have, not from memory
A last check before you call it done
Option A — Install the official plugin (recommended)
